title: WebXSkill: Skill Learning for Autonomous Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.13318v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autonomous web agents powered by large language models (LLMs) remain brittle on long-horizon browser workflows. A key bottleneck is a grounding gap in existing skill formulations: textual workflow skills provide natural language guidance but cannot be directly executed, while code-based skills execute without giving the agent step-level guidance for adaptation or recovery. We introduce WebXSkill, a framework that bridges this gap with executable skills, each pairing a parameterized action program with step-level natural-language guidance. WebXSkill operates in three stages: skill extraction mines reusable action subsequences from readily available synthetic agent trajectories and abstracts them into parameterized skills, skill organization indexes them into a URL-based graph for context-aware retrieval, and skill deployment exposes two complementary modes, grounded mode for fully automated execution and guided mode where skills serve

translated_title: WebXSkill：面向自主网页智能体的技能学习
translated_abstract: 由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的自主网页智能体在长时程浏览器工作流中仍然表现脆弱。一个关键瓶颈是现有技能形式中存在的“接地”鸿沟：文本工作流技能能够提供自然语言指导但无法直接执行，而基于代码的技能虽可执行，却无法为智能体提供用于适应或恢复的步骤级指导。我们提出了WebXSkill，这是一个通过可执行技能来弥合这一鸿沟的框架，其中每个技能都将参数化的动作程序与步骤级自然语言指导相配对。WebXSkill分三个阶段运行：技能提取阶段从易于获得的合成智能体轨迹中挖掘可重用的动作子序列，并将其抽象为参数化技能；技能组织阶段将这些技能索引到基于URL的图中，以实现上下文感知的检索；技能部署阶段则提供两种互补模式，即用于全自动执行的接地模式，以及技能作为……的引导模式。
tldr: WebXSkill提出了一种将参数化动作程序与步骤级自然语言指导相结合的可执行技能框架，通过技能提取、组织和部署三个阶段，弥合了网页智能体中文本技能不可执行与代码技能缺乏步骤级指导之间的鸿沟。
en_tdlr: WebXSkill introduces executable skills that pair parameterized action programs with step-level natural-language guidance, bridging the gap between non-executable textual skills and guidance-lacking code skills for autonomous web agents through skill extraction, organization, and deployment stages.
